instruction: Review every change from benchmark-base through the current worktree, including staged, unstaged, untracked, and deleted files. Do not fix or stage anything. retention.eligible(records, cutoff) returns ids in original order only for records with created < cutoff and pinned false. Records at cutoff must be retained. audit.count_by_owner(records) returns a dictionary counting each owner string. Every input record has id, created, pinned, and owner. Empty records must return [] and {} respectively. Report defects in the final on-disk candidate, attributing each to the responsible function.
